DIAGNOSIS READY: Absence Seizures (Childhood Absence Epilepsy)

The clinical picture of brief staring spells, unresponsiveness, and a specific "muddy taste" (gustatory aura) strongly points to focal or generalized absence seizures rather than MS or other conditions. Given the patient's age and semiology, this is the most likely etiology.
